name: Swings
bio: Moon Ji-hoon, better known by the stage name Swings, is a South Korean rapper. Formerly under the label Brand New Music, he is currently contracted under his own record label, Just Music Entertainment.

credits.title: Wild Eyes: The Woman of the Prince
credits.overview: Eun Woo infiltrates the palace to kill Crown Prince Lee Hyun, only to fall in love with him.

credits.title: Tazza: The Song of Beelzebub
credits.overview: Jang Taeyoung, who believes he has everything after building a successful online casino business, loses it all to his former best friend and namesake, Park Taeyoung. The two reunite on the international poker circuit for a high-stakes battle of revenge.
